draft.notes: Seamless is a delivery marketplace for local restaurants, not a restaurant or listed catalog brand. Dining is supported by the store’s food-delivery description, Chase’s explicit Seamless listing, and Citi’s restaurant-delivery definition; issuer-specific coding may still vary.
